message: Hi Alex, it's Chloe at Rapid Plumbing, sounds good, let's do it. How do I pay and when do you start?
reply: Great to have you on board, Chloe! I'll send a secure invoice link today for the $900 fix pack - pay by card or bank transfer. Once it's paid, I'll start within 1-2 business days and keep you posted as I go. If you want the $250/month care plan for ongoing upkeep, just say so and I'll add it. Talk soon!
